Matterhaul | Infra Eng, AI Eng, Founding Marketer | SF (SoMa) | ONSITE (4 days/week) | Full-time | matterhaul.com

Matterhaul is building an AI-native ERP for the $2T physical goods supply chain. We are replacing 30-year-old legacy systems with a unified data layer and agents that have already cut customer quote times by 40%.

We are a tight-knit founding team with meaningful runway (ex-Stripe, Meraki, Verkada, Pinterest) and are hiring for three founding roles: - Founding Infra Engineer: 5+ years experience. Lead our migration to AWS/Aurora. We need someone with reliability "battle scars" who has built and owned infra from the ground up. - Founding Applied AI Engineer: Senior Eng with production LLM experience OR a hungry, AI-native early-career builder. - Founding Marketer: Strategy-first IC focused on product marketing and events for our relationship-driven customer base.

US Work Authorization Required If you’re interested email britta.dance@matterhaul.com with your information.
